title: Delivery targets, editors and EU hosting
description: How one Kiekkist theme (DESIGN.md, DTCG tokens, pages) is delivered per target, which editor fits which client, token mappings and EU hosting options. Facts checked 2026-10-30; re-check version lines before promising them. Not endorsements.

sources.title: Maintainer's research notes: Entscheidungs-Leitfaden CMS- & Shop-Wahl

items.name: Astro (default)
items.version: 7.x (7.0.0 released 2026-06-22; 7.4.4 on 2026-10-30); 6.x line from 2026-03-10 still common. Check engines with npm view astro engines before promising a Node version
items.summary: Static by default, components per section, content collections via content.config.ts, CSP API stable, zero JS by default.
items.fits: new brochure and service sites, editorial sites, small shops with a payment link or headless commerce
items.avoid: teams that must edit layouts visually without any developer
items.fonts: theme woff2 in public/fonts; Fonts API only if build output verified free of remote URLs
traps: image optimiser strips metadata (C2PA) — see privacy-eu AI rule

items.name: WordPress block theme
items.version: WordPress 7.0 (2026-05-20), PHP >= 7.4; theme.json schema v3; Interactivity API since 6.5
items.summary: Block theme with theme.json generated from tokens, one pattern per section, locked palette and type scale, contentOnly locking for structured sections.
items.fits: existing WordPress editorial teams, clients who must edit everything themselves
items.avoid: sites nobody edits (maintenance without benefit); page builders on top
items.tokens: settings.color.palette, typography.fontFamilies with local fontFace, fontSizes, spacing.spacingSizes, custom.*
traps: emoji script and s.w.org DNS prefetch: remove
AI Connectors (Anthropic/Google/OpenAI) off unless decided with DPA
plugins are the main risk: list each with purpose
hosting: managed WordPress at a German host

items.name: Elementor kit structure (honest path)
items.version: kit export/import via wp elementor kit export|import (content, templates, site-settings)
items.summary: Deliver global colors/fonts from tokens (hex fallback) plus a style-guide page; section templates only when an import test in a disposable WordPress passes kk check and kk compare.
items.fits: clients who keep an existing Elementor site
items.tokens: system_colors/custom_colors (hex), system_typography/custom_typography; fluid type becomes three breakpoint sizes
traps: element JSON is not a documented stable public schema
lower fidelity: say so in the offer

items.name: Next.js
items.version: 16 (2025-10-21), Node >= 20.9; Turbopack default; proxy.ts replaces middleware.ts on Node runtime
items.summary: App router; static export (output: 'export') or standalone server in Docker; tokens.css plus CSS Modules; Tailwind v4 only on request with generated @theme.
items.fits: clients whose developers already work in React; app-like sites
items.avoid: brochure sites without a React team
items.tokens: tokens.css in root layout; optional @theme file
traps: static export: no server actions, ISR, cookies()/headers(), config rewrites/headers, proxy.ts, default image optimiser
hosting: standalone: Coolify/VPS in DE or FR

items.name: Plain HTML
items.summary: Theme pages cleaned for production with identical header/footer, per-page meta, sitemap, robots, 404, header templates (.htaccess/_headers).
items.fits: one-pagers, campaign and landing pages, up to about five pages

items.name: Webflow / Framer (later)
items.summary: No tested import path that keeps components editable; deliver variables list and pages as visual reference only. US SaaS: informed choice, not default.

items.name: No CMS (Markdown/MDX in repo)
items.client_edits: nothing directly; agency or agent edits files
items.fits: default for brochure sites with a care plan

items.name: Sveltia CMS
items.data: Git (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea/Forgejo); no server, no DB
caveats: no visual page building (felt as a gap in agency practice)

items.name: Decap CMS
items.data: Git incl. Gitea/Forgejo backend; OAuth helper needed

items.name: Directus (self-host)
items.client_edits: admin app plus visual editing on the live page
items.fits: in-context editing with EU data control
caveats: BSL licence: check current revenue threshold for larger clients

items.name: Storyblok
items.client_edits: visual editor with live preview of the site

items.name: Payload
items.client_edits: admin from code, blocks, live preview

items.name: WordPress Site Editor
items.client_edits: texts, images, menus, posts, pages from patterns; locked palette and scale

rules.locks: color.custom:false, customGradient:false, defaultPalette:false, defaultGradients:false, typography.customFontSize:false, defaultFontSizes:false

items.name: DTCG to Elementor globals

rules.type: roles into system/custom typography; clamp min/mid/max into mobile/tablet/desktop

caveats: no OKLCH, no fluid type: fidelity loss
